projects.title: Smart Healthcare & Telemedicine Assistant & Predictive Dashboard
projects.tagline: An end-to-end interactive decision support platform for Healthcare & Telemedicine with predictive analytics.
projects.problem_statement: In the Healthcare & Telemedicine domain, practitioners and users face high overhead and fragmentation. This project delivers an automated, user-friendly solution to streamline operations and provide actionable intelligence.
projects.target_audience: Healthcare & Telemedicine professionals, researchers, students, and organizations seeking efficiency.

key_modules.description: Collects, validates, and preprocesses domain datasets (CSV/JSON/APIs) with automated anomaly filtering.
Processes domain trends, summarizes risks, and generates contextual recommendations.
Visualizes key performance indicators (KPIs), metric graphs, and exportable summary cards.

projects.evaluation_winning_tip: Demonstrate live data filtering and show the exact accuracy/evaluation metrics to impress examiners.

projects.title: Automated Healthcare & Telemedicine Report Generator & Summarizer
projects.tagline: Transform complex domain documents into executive summaries and structured infographics.
projects.problem_statement: In the Healthcare & Telemedicine domain, practitioners and users face high overhead and fragmentation. This project delivers an automated, user-friendly solution to streamline operations and provide actionable intelligence.

key_modules.description: Extracts text from multi-page PDFs/reports and indexes chunks into FAISS/ChromaDB.
Retrieves relevant sections and generates section-wise structured executive summaries.
Exports formatted PDF/HTML briefs with cited sources and confidence scores.

projects.evaluation_winning_tip: Show a side-by-side comparison between the raw 30-page PDF and the generated 1-page structured brief.

key_modules.description: Simulates continuous streaming telemetry/event logs with injected outlier incidents.
